content: {"rule": "K-S2", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge enters an UNDERDETERMINED verdict for D5 and states that the sign's sense is left open, so K-S2's bar on treating an open-sense verse as underdetermined directly governs this text.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D5 vs C5 (Isaiah 7:14): UNDERDETERMINED -- [CR2] G answers the 'almah/bethulah and near-fulfillment rows, leaving the sign's sense open.", "rule_words": "That a single verse does not state a link or its contrary is never a ground for STANDS or UNDERDETERMINED, for either side. A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand.", "room": "A verse that carries two senses at once is not open. Both senses stand. -- weighed as: (1) an open sense permits UNDERDETERMINED, versus (2) a verse carrying two senses is not open and both senses stand.", "why": "K-S2 forbids using an allegedly open sense as a ground for UNDERDETERMINED, but the judge's stated reason is precisely that the sign's sense is left open."}
